title: Ukraine: Russian strikes hit bridges in Kyiv, mayor says
summary: Kyiv's mayor said Russian forces have hit bridges on the Dnipro River. Ukraine launched a massive attack on Russia earlier on Monday, hitting the Crimean Bridge. DW has the latest.

image.caption: Russian strikes damaged bridges across Dnipro in early October too, seen here [FILE: October 2, 2026]Image: State Emergency Service of Ukraine/REUTERS

blocks.text: Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko said two major bridges in the Ukrainian capital were struck in an overnight Russian attack.
The strikes damaged critical infrastructure and disrupted water and heating in parts of the city, Klitschko said.
Ukraine on Monday attacked Russia, targeting Moscow with drones and striking an important rail bridge in the annexed Crimean peninsula.
The latest exchanges come as negotiators from Ukraine, Europe and the US discuss future talks with Russia on finding a path to peace.
